page.overview:
Who is Cherry Gold and MandoPony?

Cherry Gold is the placeholder name of a male background Earth pony who appears in the season four episode Equestria Games. He has a yellow coat, brown mane, green eyes, and his cutie mark is a pair of cherries on their stems. He is unnamed in the series.

Cherry Gold bears a similarity to MandoPony. MandoPony is an original character of musician Andrew Stein, known for producing original and My Little Pony-inspired music and for playing mandolin for William Anderson on a short cue for Magical Mystery Cure that was cut from the final version of the episode. On DeviantArt, artist Sabrina Alberghetti stated in early February 2013 that MandoPony would never be seen "in the show - it's just not possible. Well, I'm sure it could be, but it's not worth the trouble" On Twitter in late April 2013, comic artist Amy Mebberson pointed out MandoPony's appearance in to Stein, who then stated in response "Oh my goodness! What?! When? How?! WHAT ARE WE RUNNING FROM".

In response to Cherry Gold's appearance in Equestria Games, Stein stated on Twitter in early May 2014 "THAT'S NOT MANDOPONY, IT'S ... uh ... um ... o.O ... 'cherry'pony? ... I got nothing" and in early August 2014 "uhh ..." and "I can neither confirm nor deny this pony's identity". On Twitter in January 2015, show director Jim Miller, after stating "We don't put fan OCs in the show", was replied to with a link to the My Little Pony Friendship is Magic Wiki's "MandoPony" article (which at the time treated Cherry Gold and MandoPony as one character), and stated in reply to that "Yeah, that's NOT Mando. It's merely a coincidence. It's bound to happen since a lot of OCs are based on..." "...existing background ponies, and we sometimes recolour incidentals all to fill out crowds. No conspiracy here." Despite implication of these Twitter replies of Miller's, Cherry Gold's design has not been used for another show character.

Cherry Gold and MandoPony have the same design and similar color schemes. They resemble Joe and Feather Bangs. Cherry Gold has the same cutie mark as Cherry Fizzy, "Black Stone", "Cormano", "Cherry Strudel", and S05E06 Unnamed Earth Stallion #7. MandoPony resembles the Braeburn variant seen in Leap of Faith and, sometimes, in Equestria Games.
